environment.description: Kubernetes pod running the WebSocket service connected to PostgreSQL 15 with standard role 'app_user' that has SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE on all tenant tables. No row-level security policies are enabled. The database connection string uses a single shared role. Tables: projects, tasks, documents - all contain a tenant_id column but no RLS policy is attached. The service is exposed via a plain TCP load balancer with no request inspection.

config.network: TCP L4 load balancer, no WAF
